capabilities.foundly_current: Recorded availability produces bookable slots, distribution favors calendars with fewer recorded appointments in the requested period, stale selections are rejected, and private in-app reminders survive restart. HTTP booking and UI forms are implemented. Reminder execution now binds to the current authorized planner, preserving explicit recipient delegation. Revoked/suspended planners cannot borrow worker rights; isolated commits and rotating bounded batches preserve unrelated work and restart idempotency. Explicit Google Calendar read-only reconciliation now retains complete bounded time-window occupancy through all pages, including exclusive all-day dates in the provider timezone. Native conflicts, slot selection and booking use the observation. Calendar/account/revision/freshness/window changes invalidate coverage and prior selections; partial/error responses preserve the prior observation. Titles and attendees are not copied. Current authenticated HTTP and production-handler tests pass with isolated provider fixtures.
capabilities.gap: Live authorized Google account reconciliation and actual browser/keyboard/viewport acceptance remain UNVERIFIED. Each observed window is bounded to 31 days / 10000 source events and expires after 15 minutes; uncovered or stale times fail closed.
capabilities.required_change: Verify the implemented Google read-only reconciliation against a live authorized account and exercise actual scheduling/browser acceptance.
